title: 第12章 吃香的炼丹师

content_zh:
“行啊你，牛，哈哈哈，我都没看过他这么吃瘪过呢！”高宏志拍了拍楚云凡的肩膀，挤眉弄眼的说道。
而此时，其他的同学似乎才刚刚反应了过来，都一副兀自不敢相信的模样。
连副班长唐思雨也睁着一双大眼睛，带着几分惊诧的看着楚云凡。
“刚才的实战，大家都看到了，虎魔拳的威力甚大，尤其是对你们而言，所以要小心一些！”秦武道，没有因为两人受伤就有什么反应，他是退伍的军人，见过的残酷场面不知凡几，早就没有感觉了。
“你们在修炼上有什么不理解的，都可以来问我，下面我再给你们讲解一下一些修炼上的要点！”
秦武讲解起了修炼虎魔拳之中一些常见的问题和如何克服。
这些都是最为宝贵的经验，如果是以前的时代，这就是所谓的不传之秘，但是在现代，许多人都会将这些心得公开，甚至一些武学修炼的心得会被放在网上公开付费下载，以此赚钱，同时也是传播武学。
人类不过是数百年就能够将超古代文明复原到这个地步，和这种打破门户之见的新式观点，有很大的关系。
楚云凡盘坐着，一边运转《天长地久皇极功》，将真气都调集到了双臂上，来加速恢复，一边回想着刚才的战斗。
虽然只是一场战斗而已，但是冯德英在虎魔拳上的领悟和他相当，因此这一战，收获很大。
他能够感觉到，在教室的另外一边，冯德英阴鸷的目光一直都落在自己的身上，没有离开过。
知道这一次算是将冯德英给得罪狠了，不过他也不在乎，这一战也极大的增强了他的自信，就算是班上的天才又怎么样，只要给他足够的时间，都可以统统踩在脚下。
一节课的时间很快就过去了，到了下课的时候，楚云凡身上的伤口就已经恢复的差不多了，现代科技催生下的医疗水平已经不是以前公历时代所能够想象的了的。
“好了，今天的课程就到此为止了，下课！明天后天两天是双休日，大家在家里也可以好好练练虎魔拳！”秦武道，“对了，楚云凡，你来我的办公室一下！”
楚云凡有点奇怪，因为秦武还从来没有单独见过他，之前他也实在是太过平庸了，秦武连单独见他的兴趣都没有。
楚云凡跟着秦武，来到了秦武的办公室。
“老师，不知道您找我是为了？”楚云凡直接了当的开口问道。
秦武看了一眼楚云凡，说道：“之前包括我在内的老师都小看了你，还以为你资质平庸，现在看起来，你的资质确实寻常，不过你学习武技的速度却很快，看来应该是你之前没有接触过武技，所以这方面的天赋没有被发现！”
“虽然人们一直说天赋天赋，但是实际上，天赋也分很多种，就武道上来说，也分很多种，有的人天生领悟力强，有的人在武技修行上举一反三，有些人身体资质非常好，天生神力，不修行也比修行的人更强，而你应该属于修行武技上的天才！”
秦武绕道了办公桌后面，在办公椅上坐了下来，继续说道：“你之前资质平庸也就算了，既然你在这方面有天赋，就不该浪费，现在我人类为什么如此繁荣昌盛，甚至还占据了昆仑界的大片土地进行殖民，就是因为我们改变了以往那种狭隘的选拔人才的模式，唯才是举！”

“你在内功修为上天赋一般，加上出身普通，家里也没能力给你提供足够修行用的资源，所以你这天赋很可能会被耽误，怎么样，有没有考虑进军队？”秦武看着楚云凡问道。
“进军队？”楚云凡愣一下，也没有想过秦武居然会提出这个意见。
“是的，进军队，于公来说，人类虽然占据了昆仑界大量的土地，但是实际上，一直都处于危险之中，连地球本土都被逼的只剩下了几个基地市，其他全部沦为妖兽的领地，更别说昆仑界的妖兽，比地球上的更强，军队就是保卫人类的最大防线，自然需要吸收人类之中各种各样的精英！”秦武缓缓说道，“于私来说，以你们家的家境，肯定没办法像冯德英，高宏志他们一样，为你提供大量的资源，但是军队可以，只要你有天赋，军队可以为你提供大量的资源，比一般大学毕业出来的毕业生前景也不差，甚至更好，而且你的天赋是在武技修炼上，这都是需要大量实战才能成长起来的，而实战还有比战场更好的地方么？”

content_en:
"Okay, you, awesome, hahaha, I've never seen him so deflated before!" Gao Hongzhi patted Chu Yunfan on the shoulder and said with a wink.
At this time, the other students seemed to have just reacted, and they all looked like they couldn't believe it.
Even the deputy squad leader Tang Siyu opened his big eyes and looked at Chu Yunfan with a bit of surprise.
"Everyone has seen the actual battle just now. The Tiger Demon Fist is very powerful, especially for you, so be careful!" Qin Wudao did not react because the two were injured. He is a retired soldier. He has seen countless cruel scenes and has long since lost any feeling.
"If you have anything you don't understand about cultivation, you can come and ask me. I will explain some of the key points in cultivation to you below!"
Qin Wu explained some common problems in practicing Tiger Demon Fist and how to overcome them.
These are the most precious experiences. In previous eras, this would have been a so-called secret that was not passed on. But in modern times, many people will make these experiences public, and even some martial arts training experiences will be put online for public download for a fee, in order to make money, and at the same time spread martial arts.
The fact that humans were able to restore super-ancient civilization to this point in just a few hundred years has a lot to do with this new perspective that breaks down sectarian views.
Chu Yunfan sat cross-legged, while running the "Eternal Emperor's Ultimate Kung", mobilizing all the energy into his arms to speed up recovery, while thinking about the battle just now.
Although it was just a battle, Feng Deying's understanding of Tiger Demon Fist was comparable to his, so this battle was very rewarding.
He could feel that on the other side of the classroom, Feng Deying's sinister gaze had always been on him and never left.
He knew that Feng Deying had been severely offended this time, but he didn't care. This battle also greatly enhanced his self-confidence. Even if he was a genius in the class, as long as he was given enough time, he could step on them all.
The class time passed quickly, and by the time the get out of class ended, Chu Yunfan's wounds had almost recovered. The medical level promoted by modern technology was no longer what could be imagined in the previous Gregorian calendar era.
"Okay, that's the end of today's class. get out of class is over! Tomorrow and the day after tomorrow are weekends. You can also practice Tiger Demon Fist at home!" Qin Wu said, "By the way, Chu Yunfan, come to my office!"
Chu Yunfan was a little strange, because Qin Wu had never seen him alone before, and he was too mediocre before. Qin Wu was not even interested in meeting him alone.
Chu Yunfan followed Qin Wu to Qin Wu's office.
"Teacher, I wonder why you are looking for me?" Chu Yunfan asked directly.
Qin Wu glanced at Chu Yunfan and said: "Before, teachers including me underestimated you and thought you had mediocre qualifications. Now it seems that your qualifications are indeed ordinary, but you learn martial arts very quickly. It seems that you have not been exposed to martial arts before, so your talent in this area has not been discovered!"
"Although people always talk about natural talents, in fact, there are many types of talents. In terms of martial arts, there are also many types. Some people are born with strong understanding, and some people can draw inferences in martial arts practice. Some people have very good physical aptitudes and are born with divine power. Even without practicing, they are stronger than those who practice martial arts. And you should be a genius in practicing martial arts!"
Qin Wu detoured behind the desk, sat down on the office chair, and continued: "It's okay for you to have mediocre qualifications before. Since you have talent in this area, you shouldn't waste it. The reason why humans are so prosperous now and even occupy a large area of ​​Kunlun for colonization is because we have changed the previous narrow selection of talents. Meritocracy!"
"You are very talented in internal skills.Generally speaking, plus you come from an ordinary background and your family is unable to provide you with enough resources for practice, so your talent is likely to be delayed. What about it, have you considered joining the army? Qin Wu looked at Chu Yunfan and asked.
"Join the army? "Chu Yunfan was stunned for a moment and never thought that Qin Wu would actually put forward this opinion.
"Yes, entering the army, Yu Gong said, although humans occupy a large amount of land in the Kunlun realm, in fact, they are always in danger. Even the mainland of the earth has been forced to have only a few base cities left, and the rest have been reduced to the territory of monsters. Not to mention that the monsters in the Kunlun realm are stronger than those on the earth. The army is the biggest line of defense to protect mankind, and naturally it needs to absorb all kinds of elites among humans! "Qin Wu said slowly, "Privately speaking, with your family's background, you are definitely not able to provide you with a lot of resources like Feng Deying and Gao Hongzhi, but the army can. As long as you have talent, the army can provide you with a lot of resources. The prospects are no worse or even better than those of ordinary university graduates. And your talent is in the practice of martial arts, which requires a lot of actual combat to grow. Is there any better place for actual combat than the battlefield? "
